description: Provider-neutral deployment contract. IZAKHONO owns the application lifecycle; external infrastructure is an adapter, never the system of record.
selectionPolicy: Use owned when an owned runtime endpoint is configured and healthy.
Use a neutral Docker VPS runtime when owned runtime is unavailable.
Use edge adapters only for their declared edge responsibilities.
Use Vercel only when explicitly selected or when a configured fallback policy permits it.
Never make business data, deployment state, domains or customer configuration dependent on a provider-specific API.
